memory_update.text: AMSC is the cleanest US-listed underfollowed direct candidate for the HVDC/FACTS/grid-stability node because its D-VAR product is explicitly a STATCOM/FACTS-adjacent reactive-power and voltage-control solution.

PLPC is a strong underfollowed second-order transmission-hardware candidate, but direct HVDC/FACTS component exposure is not yet proven and must be verified through project/customer/specification evidence.
HUBB is a large-cap component/platform candidate with instrument-transformer and substation apparatus exposure; include only if later layers accept less pure but still component-level grid exposure.
GEV should be retained as the reference OEM/system-integrator anchor for mapping component suppliers, but not as the main underfollowed alpha candidate.

US-listed universe lacks many pure HVDC reactor/filter/instrument-transformer specialists; external context points to non-US-listed India/Canada/Europe suppliers, so a later international pass should expand beyond US listings.

node: HVDC, FACTS, reactors, harmonic filters, instrument transformers, and grid-stability components
summary: Layer 1B expansion for US-listed direct/public-market exposure to HVDC, FACTS, STATCOM, instrument-transformer, transmission-hardware, and grid-stability components. The reference lane is anchored by GE Vernova as the obvious large OEM/system integrator. The underfollowed lane is stronger in niche STATCOM/grid electronics and transmission hardware than in pure HVDC reactor/filter suppliers, because several pure component candidates identified in external context are non-US-listed. Best US-listed discovery candidates for later verification are AMSC and PLPC; HUBB is included as a large-cap component/platform candidate with instrument-transformer and substation exposure, but less pure.
